scope: Requested chat and Activity changes before Phase 2; Phase 2 has not started.

before.chat: Plan decisions, stage progress and inline model reasoning appeared alongside results.
before.activity: Stage/validation messages and collapsed reasoning; answer model calls were not recorded in Activity.

after.chat: Answer and computed facts, a collapsed optional Explanation, and a results link. Clarification choices, Stop and review controls remain available.
after.activity: Raw returned reasoning grouped by question, one entry per model-call attempt including retries and answer composition.
after.missing_reasoning: Explicit label when the model returned no reasoning or historical reasoning was not recorded.
after.persistence: Call IDs correlate start, streamed fragments, full reasoning and completion. Partial failed-call reasoning survives pagination and reload.
after.call_count_example: Route + failed plan + retried plan + answer = four Activity entries, including the answer call with no returned reasoning.

browser.scope: Includes confirmed undirected biclique conversion, lost-response recovery, chat/activity reloads and existing controls. Model responses are authored fixtures.

setup_notes: Initial native/planner test invocation lacked GRAPHMINE_ANALYTICS_PYTHON and was stopped. Corrected runs passed; initial planner evidence is retained as planning-environment-error.xml.
An initial browser process ended with SIGTERM after five passes; the complete rerun passed all 52 cases.
Planner regression suite uses the established frozen GPU-capable runtime; native browser cases use the current dev CPU runtime.

historical_baseline: Phase 1 baseline artifacts remain the original pre-change measurements.
